pix_account_uid.description:
UID of the Pix Account to change the receiver's Pix key.

This field is useful when you want to change the Pix key with the financial provider.

**Important**: Only Pix accounts that are active (status `active`) are accepted.

address.description: Payer address. Required for Pix with Billing registration type for Sicoob bank

status.description:
Pix status.

`opened`: Open Pix charge (unpaid). [Initial State]
`paid`: Pix charge paid.
`overdue`: Overdue Pix charge.
`canceled`: Pix charge canceled.
`generation_failed`: Pix charge created, but was not registered with the bank.

expire_at.description: Date and time of expiration. ISO8601 format

revoke_days.description: Number of days active after expiration

fine_type.description:
Type of fine:
                    * `0` No fine (`none`)
                    * `1` By amount (`amount`)
                    * `2` By percentage (`percentage`)
                    On return the data come in the `fine` object.

fine_amount.description: Fine amount in reals. Required when `fine_type` = `amount`.

interest_type.description:
Type of interest:
                    * `0` Does not apply / exempt (`none`)
                    * `1` Daily amount — calendar days (`daily_amount_calendar`)
                    * `2` Daily percentage — calendar days (`daily_percentage_calendar`)
                    * `3` Monthly percentage — calendar days (`monthly_percentage_calendar`)
                    * `4` Annual percentage — calendar days (`yearly_percentage_calendar`)
                    * `5` Daily amount — business days (`daily_amount_business`)
                    * `6` Daily percentage — business days (`daily_percentage_business`)
                    * `7` Monthly percentage — business days (`monthly_percentage_business`)
                    * `8` Annual percentage — business days (`yearly_percentage_business`)
                    On return the data come in the `interest` object.

interest_amount.description: Daily interest amount in reals. Required when `interest_type` is by amount (`daily_amount_*`).

interest_percentage.description: Interest percentage. Required when `interest_type` is by percentage.

reduction_type.description:
Type of reduction:
                    * `1` By amount (`amount`)
                    * `2` By percentage (`percentage`)
                    * `3` Does not apply — removes the reduction (`none`)
                    On return the data come in the `reduction` object.

reduction_amount.description: Reduction amount in reals. Required when `reduction_type` = `amount`.

discount_type.description:
Type of discount applied to the `discount_*` fields (null/absent = no discount):
                    * `1` Fixed amount (`fixed_amount`)
                    * `2` Fixed percentage (`fixed_percentage`)
                    * `3` Early payment by amount — calendar days (`advance_amount_calendar`)
                    * `4` Early payment by amount — business days (`advance_amount_business`)
                    * `5` Early payment by percentage — calendar days (`advance_percentage_calendar`)
                    * `6` Early payment by percentage — business days (`advance_percentage_business`)
                    Early payment modes (`3`–`6`) accept only one range. On return the type comes in `discounts.type`.

discount_amount.description: Value of 1st discount in reals. Required when `discount_type` is by amount.

discount_percentage.description: Percentage of 1st discount. Required when `discount_type` is by percentage.

discount_days.description: Days before expiration when the 1st discount is valid.

discount_second_days.description: Days before expiration when the 2nd discount is valid.

discount_third_days.description: Days before expiration when the 3rd discount is valid.

created_via_api.description: Indicates if Pix was created by API

created_at.description: Date and time of record creation

updated_at.description: Date and time of last record update
